meta.title: Vendor fills a dropdown column "Make": leave it unselected when it is required
gaps: Verify that the Make column is configured as a required dropdown and inspect its available options.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Verify that the Make column is configured as a required dropdown and inspect its available options.

steps.note: Open the prepared event state for the vendor-side bid test.
Act as Vendor A in the supplier portal while keeping the buyer session separate.
Open the live RFQ's pricing sheet.
Enter the valid quote while leaving the required Make field untouched.
Verify submission is refused because the required Make dropdown has no selected value.
